channel.title: Daily Newsletter (Michael)
channel.description: The Daily Newsletter read aloud each morning: Egypt, the world, the region and the markets, about half an hour. Read by Michael.
channel.itunes:author: Daily Newsletter

item.title: Weekly Recap, week to November 28
item.description: The Ring Road fire, an IMF deal, a weaker pound, war across the Gulf and Wall Street's best week in over a year. Read the edition: https://daily-newsletter-eg.vercel.app/#2026-11-28-recap

item.title: Friday, November 27
item.description: Driver detained over Ring Road fire, donations hit EGP 200m, one-year T-bill yield at 26.35%, and Iranian drones kill two in Kuwait. Read the edition: https://daily-newsletter-eg.vercel.app/#2026-11-27

item.title: Thursday, November 26
item.description: Ring Road tanker fire kills 31, IMF staff deal worth about $2.3bn, Maersk to return to Suez, pound weakens 0.8%, new US tariffs. Read the edition: https://daily-newsletter-eg.vercel.app/#2026-11-26

item.title: Wednesday, November 25
item.description: Suez Canal revenue doubles in November, phone prices up 60%, Houthis hit Riyadh's PIF Tower again, chip stocks slide. Read the edition: https://daily-newsletter-eg.vercel.app/#2026-11-25

item.title: Tuesday, November 24
item.description: Misr Life opens IPO books below fair value; Egypt and Iraq lift visas; Nasdaq soars as Huang returns to Nvidia Read the edition: https://daily-newsletter-eg.vercel.app/#2026-11-24

item.title: Monday, November 23
item.description: Pound slips past 54.50 as EGX30 drops 2.85%, LNG cargoes bound for Egypt turn away, and COP31 ends without a deal. Read the edition: https://daily-newsletter-eg.vercel.app/#2026-11-23

item.title: Sunday, November 22
item.description: EGPC hires Weatherford to restart 100 idle wells, Goldman sees rates on hold, Misr Life readies IPO, Wall Street's worst week Read the edition: https://daily-newsletter-eg.vercel.app/#2026-11-22

item.title: Weekly Recap, week to November 21
item.description: An IMF deal closes Egypt's loan program, the minimum wage rises, and Wall Street has its worst week since 2020. Read the edition: https://daily-newsletter-eg.vercel.app/#2026-11-21-recap
